## Context / Problem

`output_mode` (src/rebar/llm/structured.py:43) blanket-forces PromptedOutput whenever
`thinking=True`, and its docstring (:50-56) states the rationale: "pairing extended thinking
with a native/forced output constraint is the documented Anthropic 400". E1 (recorded on the
selection bug ticket) measured that rationale stale: the historic 400 was tool_choice x
thinking; `outputConfig` json_schema + thinking succeeds on the wire today (sonnet adaptive,
haiku budget 2048). The blanket guard therefore forces the prompted path — the very path this
epic exists to harden — even on cells where native output is measured-safe under thinking.

## Approach

Add a capability field `native_output_with_thinking: bool = False` to the capabilities model
in src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py (fail-closed default). Change the guard in `output_mode` to:
NativeOutput iff `caps.native_structured_output` AND (`not thinking` OR
`caps.native_output_with_thinking`). Rewrite the docstring to the measured facts, including
that tools x thinking x native suppresses tool calling (E1: 2/2 skipped) — which is why this
function's single call site, src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py:181, is the no-tools single-shot
path and the agentic runner never consults it; the no-tools scoping is structural, not a
parameter. No behavior changes in THIS ticket: every existing capability record keeps the
default False, so thinking still forces prompted everywhere until the rows story adds measured
cells. That keeps this slice independently landable with pure contrast tests.

## Scope

- src/rebar/llm/structured.py — the guard + docstring in `output_mode`
- src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py — the new field (default False)
- tests/unit/test_structured.py (or the capabilities test file) — contrast tests

## Testing

Unit tier, config-effect contrast through the real read path (shared test-design standard §6):

- caps(native=True, with_thinking=True) + thinking=True -> NativeOutput (new behavior gate).
- caps(native=True, with_thinking=False) + thinking=True -> PromptedOutput (default preserved;
  negative control proving no cell flips in this ticket).
- caps(native=True) + thinking=False -> NativeOutput; caps(native=False) -> PromptedOutput
  (both existing branches pinned unchanged).
- Mutation check: reverting the guard to the blanket `not thinking` form turns the first test
  RED.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The four contrast cases above pass — checked by the new unit tests.
- [x] No existing test changes: the current suite passes unmodified, proving zero behavior
      change at defaults — checked by `make test`.
- [x] The docstring states the measured facts (tool_choice x thinking as the historic 400;
      tool-suppression as the no-tools scoping reason) and cites the E1 evidence location —
      checked in code review.
